primary.notes_base: 2026 Michelin Guide Beijing 1-Star. Rating 4.6 on Gaode Maps, average 533 CNY/person. Located in a converted art gallery / museum space in Jinyu Hutong (Goldfish Lane), Wangfujing Dongcheng — one of the most artistically distinctive dining rooms in Beijing. The concept is creative elevated Northeast Chinese (东北菜 Dongbei cuisine): dishes rooted in the bold flavours of China's Northeast (Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning) are reinterpreted with contemporary technique and refined presentation. The Guobaorou (锅包肉, sweet-sour crispy pork) is repeatedly cited by reviewers as the best rendition in Beijing -- a dish most people associate with school canteens, here elevated to a precise and memorable statement. The art-museum setting -- natural light, curated walls, quiet intimate service -- is a textbook 文艺温馨 environment perfectly matching Jade's INFJ sensibility: thoughtful without being precious, distinctive without being ostentatious. Dinner hours: 17:30-21:00 (Mon-Sun). The 18:00-19:30 slot fits comfortably. RESERVATION URGENCY: Day 2 is May 3 (Labour Day Golden Week peak) -- this Michelin-starred restaurant will be fully booked. Reserve as early as possible, ideally 1-2 weeks ahead. Reservation: call the restaurant directly or via Dianping (大众点评) mini-program. Location: Wangfujing / Dongcheng -- very convenient from Mutianyu Great Wall return (bus back to Dongzhimen, then Metro Line 5 to Dengshikou or short taxi to Wangfujing, ~20 min total). Cuisine variety: completely distinct from Day 1 Peking duck (Siji Minfu), Day 14 Da Dong, and Day 15 starred restaurant -- Northeast Chinese is an entirely different culinary tradition.
primary.notes_local: 2026北京米其林一星。高德评分4.6，人均533元。位于东城区王府井金鱼胡同12号，餐厅设于一栋艺术画廊/美术馆空间内，是北京最具艺术气质的用餐环境之一。主理人以创意手法重诠东北菜：来自黑龙江、吉林、辽宁的大开大合的东北风味，在这里以现代技法和精致摆盘呈现。招牌锅包肉被小红书多位食客评为"北京最好吃的锅包肉"——一道人们记忆中的大众家常菜，在此处被重新定义为精准且令人难忘的味觉叙事。美术馆空间、自然采光、策展式墙面、安静细致的服务——是教科书级别的文艺温馨环境，完全契合Jade的INFJ气质：有深度但不做作，独特但不炫耀。晚餐营业至21:00，18:00-19:30时段完全适合。预约紧迫性：5月3日为五一黄金周高峰，米其林餐厅必须尽早预订，建议提前1-2周致电或通过大众点评小程序预约。交通：从慕田峪长城返程至东直门，乘地铁5号线至灯市口站或打车前往王府井，约20分钟即到。菜系差异：与D1四季民福烤鸭、D14大董、D15米其林星级餐厅完全不同，东北菜代表截然不同的中国饮食传统。
